notFound.why: Official 2025 base-trim catalog page lists fuel economy as "N/D" (not disclosed); other aggregator figures (15.15/14.71 l/100km) were inconsistent and could not be confirmed against an official combined NOM-163 value

Honda México's official site, press releases and dealer ficha técnica PDFs do not disclose a rendimiento/km-L figure (autocosmos.com.mx catalog shows N/D for all fields); secondary figures found (16.3, 16.1, 11.9 km/L) were inconsistent and one source conflated the HR-V's engine with the CR-V's, indicating the numbers were not reliably sourced

Honda México's official site and press releases omit the figure (autocosmos.com.mx catalog shows N/D for all fields); the recurring secondary figure (16.6 km/L) could not be traced to a verifiable source and appeared possibly conflated with the HR-V's data

BYD's own Mexico page and PDF flyer do not publish a numeric kWh/100km field (only WLTC range text); all numeric consumption figures located (15.4-18.2 kWh/100km) traced to European sources, not a Mexico-specific figure

No tesla.com/mx page or Mexican press article states a kWh/100km consumption figure; all numeric figures found (11.6-16.5 kWh/100km WLTP) came from European sources, not a Mexico-specific official figure
